identification: Postmodern Memphis-style porcelain coffee/tea service, teapot, milk jug, covered sugar, six cups and saucers, black and white striped handles. Matches the Vienna Collection (Schrems, Austria, 1980s) Heide Warlamis service in form (horn-shaped pot, stepped handles). Marked pieces carry a 'Vienna Collection-Heide Warlamis' underside stamp; no backstamp seen in lot photos, so attribution is likely but unconfirmed.
